country.name: Argentina
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language, not a substitute for a learner's language of origin. Indigenous education and language support are people-, community-, province- and institution-specific and require permanent Indigenous participation; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Argentine reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible national, provincial, City of Buenos Aires, Indigenous-community, institution or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: Argentina has a federal education system. National authorities and the Consejo Federal de Educación establish federal agreements and common priorities, while the provinces and the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires govern and implement their education systems and curricular designs. University recognition and accreditation follow separate national processes.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: Secretaría de Educación de la Nación and Consejo Federal de Educación within their legal competences
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve CUE and annex identifier where applicable, establishment name, jurisdiction, locality, management sector, level, modality, active status, offers, source vintage and review date. National records are continuously updated by jurisdictional education-statistics units.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institutional recognition, official recognition and national validity of a specific university title, non-university higher-education title validity, professional regulation, institutional evaluation, and CONEAU career or postgraduate accreditation are distinct claims.

authorities.name: Secretaría de Educación de la Nación
authorities.role: national education policy, federal information, national title-validity and university-recognition functions within its current competence

authorities.name: Consejo Federal de Educación
authorities.role: federal coordination and agreements among the Nation, provinces and Autonomous City of Buenos Aires

authorities.name: Provincial education ministries and the education authority of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires
authorities.role: jurisdictional governance, school authorization, curricular design and implementation

authorities.name: Dirección Nacional de Gestión Universitaria
authorities.role: official recognition and national validity of university titles and public university registers

authorities.name: Comisión Nacional de Evaluación y Acreditación Universitaria (CONEAU)
authorities.role: institutional evaluation and accreditation of regulated-degree and postgraduate programs within its legal remit

authorities.name: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP)
National, provincial and local child-protection authorities
authorities.role: federal and jurisdictional child-rights protection system under Law 26.061

curriculum.authority: Secretaría de Educación, Consejo Federal de Educación and each jurisdiction within their competences
curriculum.title: Núcleos de Aprendizajes Prioritarios together with current jurisdictional curricular designs
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm current CFE resolution, level, cycle, year or grade, subject, modality, jurisdictional curricular design, governing jurisdictional rule, version, effective school year and institution or community context before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: The NAP are a federally agreed common base and do not replace provincial or City of Buenos Aires curricular designs. External materials may supplement but never silently replace either layer or applicable institutional and Indigenous-community requirements.

schoolDirectory.authority: Secretaría de Educación with continuous updates by jurisdictional Unidades de Estadística Educativa
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The official register is a federal nomenclator updated continuously by jurisdictional statistics units and publishes dated releases. A CUE or map record does not by itself prove current authorization of every level, modality, annex, title or offer.

educationStatistics.authority: Secretaría de Educación — federal education-information area with jurisdictional units
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display Relevamiento Anual reference year, publication or update date, measure, unit of analysis, population, jurisdiction, sector, level or modality, source and filters. The RA captures information at 30 April; publication year must not be mistaken for the observation date.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: Dirección Nacional de Gestión Universitaria and the competent national education authority
higherEducation.accreditationAuthority: Comisión Nacional de Evaluación y Acreditación Universitaria
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Recognition of an institution, official recognition and national validity of a particular title, approval of a curriculum and cohort for non-university higher education, professional licensing by a province, institutional evaluation, and CONEAU accreditation of a regulated-degree or postgraduate program are distinct. Each claim must retain the institution, title or program, location, modality, resolution, scope and validity period.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Ley N.º 25.326 de Protección de los Datos Personales, as amended and regulated
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Ley N.º 26.061 de Protección Integral de los Derechos de las Niñas, Niños y Adolescentes, as amended
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Lawful basis, notice, data quality, security, access and correction rights, sensitive-data limits, child participation and best interests, authorization where applicable, safeguarding, incident handling and jurisdictional or institutional protocols require qualified Argentine review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Education Intercultural Bilingüe applies through federal and jurisdictional implementation with permanent participation of the relevant Indigenous peoples. Language, culture, territory, curriculum and community governance must be reviewed for the particular people and jurisdiction; one Indigenous language or Spanish must not be generalized to all communities.

completionCriteria: A qualified Argentine education reviewer is named.
National, CFE, provincial, City of Buenos Aires, Indigenous-community, university and institution responsibilities are correctly assigned.
Every school record preserves CUE, annex, jurisdiction, sector, level, modality, offers, active status, register release date and review date.
Every statistic shows RA reference year, 30 April observation basis, publication date, definition, population, jurisdiction, sector, level or modality and provenance.
Curriculum mappings identify CFE agreement, NAP, jurisdictional design, level, cycle, grade, subject, version, effective year and institutional or community context.

Every higher-education claim distinguishes institutional recognition, title recognition and national validity, non-university cohort and curriculum approval, professional regulation, evaluation and CONEAU accreditation.
Indigenous education and language requirements are reviewed with competent representatives of the relevant people and jurisdiction.
Federal and applicable jurisdictional privacy, child-protection and education rules are reviewed by qualified counsel.
Privacy, safeguarding, accessibility, incident and authorization procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
